description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。最大值为100。

默认值：

•当不设置值或设置的值小于20时，默认值为20。

•当设置的值大于100时，默认值为100。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100.

Default values:

• If you do not specify this parameter or you specify a value that is less than 20, the default value is 20.

• If you specify a value that is greater than 100, the default value is 100.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的 NextToken 参数值。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Set this parameter to the NextToken value that is returned from a previous call.
The name of the node group.

description.zh:
节点状态， 如果不填表示所有状态：Extending、UnusedNodeStopped
UnusedNodeStopping、Unused、Using、ReleaseLocking、Operating、Cutting、ClusterNodeStopped、UnusedNodeRecovering、ClusterNodeStopping、ClusterNodeRecovering、Replacing
description.en: The state of the node. If you do not specify this parameter, nodes in all states are returned. Valid values: Extending, UnusedNodeStopped, UnusedNodeStopping, Unused, Using, ReleaseLocking, Operating, Cutting, ClusterNodeStopped, UnusedNodeRecovering, ClusterNodeStopping, ClusterNodeRecovering, and Replacing.
The ID of the resource group.
